top_signals.title: US Sale of Euros for Yen Intervention Blindsided Europe, FT Says
top_signals.summary: The US blindsided the European Central Bank last week with its historic currency intervention to help Japan, only informing its counterparts in Frankfurt after it sold euros to buy the yen, the Financial Times reported, citing several people familiar with the matter.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Philippine GDP growth slows further to 2.3% in Q2 as inflation bites
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: India’s Biggest Stock Reform in Years Endures Rocky First Week
top_signals.summary: For much of the first week of trading under India’s new auction system to set closing stock prices, traders were convinced that one of the most consequential market structure reforms in years was faltering.
